from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from hashlib import sha256
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import json

class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.hidden = None
        self.text = []
        self.links = []
        self.anchor = None

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ('script', 'style'):
            self.hidden = tag
        if tag == 'a' and not self.hidden:
            self.anchor = [dict(attrs).get('href', ''), []]

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == self.hidden:
            self.hidden = None
        if tag == 'a' and self.anchor is not None:
            href, fragments = self.anchor
            self.links.append((href, ' '.join(fragments)))
            self.anchor = None

    def handle_data(self, data):
        value = ' '.join(data.split())
        if self.hidden or not value:
            return
        self.text.append(value)
        if self.anchor is not None:
            self.anchor[1].append(value)

sources = {'manning-write-for-us.html': 'https://www.manning.com/write-for-us', 'pluralsight-teach.html': 'https://www.pluralsight.com/teach'}
terms = ('liveproject', 'hands-on', 'royalt', 'compensat', 'paid', 'payment', 'proposal', 'application', 'contract', 'generative ai')
evidence = []
for filename, url in sources.items():
    raw = (root / 'raw' / filename).read_bytes()
    page = Page()
    page.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
    matches = [i for i, text in enumerate(page.text) if any(term in text.casefold() for term in terms)]
    context = sorted({j for i in matches for j in range(max(0, i-1), min(len(page.text), i+2))})
    links = [{'label': label, 'url': urljoin(url, href)} for href, label in page.links if href and urljoin(url, href).startswith('https://') and any(term in (label+' '+href).casefold() for term in ('liveproject', 'proposal', 'apply', 'application', 'author agreement', 'guidelines'))]
    evidence.append({'source': url, 'sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'context': [page.text[i] for i in context], 'links': links})
result = {'scope': 'Two committed first-party captures. Extracted text and links are leads. Terms absent from this extraction remain unknown.', 'sources': evidence}
out = root / 'provider-scope-evidence.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
